name: baseline-2026-05

query.name: baseline
query.text:
# The crawl query behind the knowledge base of May 2026 (knowledge_bases/baseline-2026-05).
#
# Written out from the code that ran those crawls: knowledge_base/citegraph.py
# (the toxicogenomics and heart/brain/lung crawls), crawl_phase2.py (the
# mechanism and organ-gap crawls), genefunc_crawl.py (the gene-function and
# gene-tox crawls) and extract.py (the extraction prompts, the gene and organ
# name maps).  A crawl's max_papers is the number of papers that run kept.
#
# The format is described in knowledge_base/crawl_queries.py.  Save an edited
# copy under a new name to keep this one as the record of the baseline.

format: 1
description: >
  Toxicogenomics literature: the hallmark-gene crawl, organ crawls (heart, brain, lung,
  intestine, testis, vascular), mechanism crawls (NRF2 dose-response, inflammasome, cell death,
  circadian, senescence), then gene-function and gene-tox crawls from the gene consensus; genes,
  organs and claims extracted from abstracts or full text; GO and KEGG/Reactome annotations for
  the genes.
crawler:
  max_depth: 2
  relevance_threshold: 0.3
  saturation_window: 20
  saturation_threshold: 0.05
  max_refs_per_paper: 30
  max_cites_per_paper: 15
  rate_limit_delay: 1.5
relevance:
  keywords: [toxicogenomics, toxicogenomic, gene expression, transcriptomics, transcriptomic, rat, rattus,
    liver, hepat, kidney, renal, nephro, heart, cardiac, lung, pulmonary, organ, tissue, hallmark, biomarker,
    signature, toxicity, toxic, adverse, human health, translational, drug-induced, chemical exposure]
  review_bonus: 0.1
  recency:
    from_year: 2020
    over_years: 5
    bonus: 0.1
  boost:
    one: 0.08
    two_or_more: 0.15
  # A paper naming a known gene and an organ word scores at least 0.35.  The 2026
  # runs took the genes from the first crawl's consensus.
  floor:
    entities_from: baseline-2026-05
    entity: genes
    tag: organ
    score: 0.35
tags:
  organ:
    liver: [liver, hepat, hepatocyte, hepatotoxic, hepatic]
    kidney: [kidney, renal, nephro, nephrotoxic, tubular]
    heart: [heart, cardiac, cardiotoxic, myocard, cardiovascular]
    lung: [lung, pulmonary, pneumo, respiratory, alveol]
    brain: [brain, neuro, cerebr, hippocamp, cortical]
    bone_marrow: [bone marrow, hematopoiet, myelotoxic]
    intestine: [intestin, gut, gastro, colonic, entero]
    spleen: [spleen, splenic]
    muscle: [muscle, myotoxic, skeletal muscle]
    thyroid: [thyroid]
    adrenal: [adrenal]
    testis: [testis, testicular, spermat]

extract:
  system: |-
    You are a scientific literature analyst specializing in toxicogenomics.
    You extract structured information from paper abstracts with precision.
    Always respond in valid JSON. Never add commentary outside the JSON.
  fields:
  - name: claims
    type: list
    describe: list of key scientific findings or conclusions, each as a concise statement
    describe_fulltext: list of key scientific findings, each as a concise statement - extract MORE detail
      than an abstract would provide
  - name: genes
    type: list
    describe: list of gene names/symbols mentioned (e.g. CYP1A1, NRF2, TP53)
    describe_fulltext: list of ALL gene names/symbols mentioned (e.g. CYP1A1, NRF2, TP53) - check methods,
      results, and supplementary references
    normalize:
      case: upper
      strip: '.,;:'
      drop_containing: [NOT EXPLICITLY, KEY GENES, CORE GENES, GENE EXPRESSION, SIGNATURE, PATHWAY, TOTAL,
        IMPLIED, LISTED]
      aliases:
        P53: TP53
        TRP53: TP53
        P53/TP53: TP53
        BCL-2: BCL2
        BCL-XL: BCL2L1
        BAK1: BAK1
        BAK: BAK1
        CASPASE-3: CASP3
        CASPASE3: CASP3
        CASPASE-9: CASP9
        CASPASE-8: CASP8
        CASPASE-1: CASP1
        TNF-Α: TNF

        TNF-ALPHA: TNF
        TNFA: TNF
        NF-ΚB: NFKB1
        NF-KB: NFKB1

        NFKB: NFKB1

        IL-1B: IL1B
        IL-10: IL10

        IL-1: IL1B

        KEAP-1: KEAP1

        HIF-1Α: HIF1A
        HIF-1A: HIF1A

        PGC-1Α: PPARGC1A
        PGC1A: PPARGC1A
        FOXO3A: FOXO3
        ERΑ: ESR1
        CYTOCHROME P450: CYP

        CYP 2E1: CYP2E1
        TGF-Β: TGFB1
        TGF-B: TGFB1
        TGF-BETA: TGFB1
        TGFB: TGFB1
        TNF-Β: LTA
        VEGF: VEGFA
        VEGF-A: VEGFA
        HGF: HGF
        FGF-21: FGF21
        GDF-15: GDF15
        P21: CDKN1A
        P27: CDKN1B
        P62: SQSTM1
        BECLIN-1: BECN1
        ERK: MAPK1
        ERK1/2: MAPK1

        AKT: AKT1
        P-AMPK: PRKAA1
        AMPK: PRKAA1
        MTOR: MTOR
        PI3K: PIK3CA
        HMOX1: HMOX1
        HMOX-1: HMOX1
        HO-1: HMOX1
        SOD: SOD1
        SOD1: SOD1
        SOD2: SOD2
        GPX: GPX1
        COX-2: PTGS2
        COX2: PTGS2
        DRP-1: DNM1L
        DRP1: DNM1L

  - name: organs
    type: list
    describe: list of organs/tissues studied (e.g. liver, kidney, heart)
    describe_fulltext: list of organs/tissues studied
    normalize:
      case: lower
      aliases:
        hepatocytes: liver
        hepatocyte: liver

  - name: methods
    type: list
    describe: list of methods used (e.g. microarray, RNA-seq, qPCR, WGCNA)
    describe_fulltext: list of methods used
  - name: species
    type: list
    describe: list of species (e.g. rat, human, mouse)
    describe_fulltext: list of species
  - name: dose_response
    type: list
    fulltext_only: true
    describe: any dose-response relationships mentioned, including specific concentrations/doses
  - name: stance

    describe: 'one of: supports_consensus, challenges_consensus, neutral, novel_finding'
  - name: confidence

  - name: summary

    describe_fulltext: 2-3 sentence summary of the paper's main contribution

    overlap: 2000
  model: claude-haiku-4-5
  workers: 6

  by: organs
  strong: 3
  moderate: 2
  # The May 2026 run counted every mention: a paper naming a gene by two

  count: mentions
